revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Table concept from the DR XD09 (11-Nov): #TEMP_INSTRUCTION replaced by TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H (one row per unit: open qty, Case Qty, SUBMIT_ASN_STS) and TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D (one row per pc: order qty and PO qty broken down to 1, PO, CASE_NO, HOLD_STS).
Rows per company of the login user (LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4)), deleted and inserted again at each run; company 1000 sees all suppliers.
CASE_NO made by XD09 from TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ (same CASE_NO for PCS_CASE pcs); input TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ added.
Added to the DR table for the rules of 4.1-4.3: SEQ_NO, CUSTOMER_CD, CUT_FLAG, GROUP_SEQ, CROSSDOCK_STATUS.
No new table TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED: open PO qty = REMAIN_QTY of the existing TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART.

objective: To get the open qty of the crossdock customer orders (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N) in the H0253 order, pre-map them to the crossdock supplier PO parts (Pra Daily Order: manifests with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X'; their part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (join MANIFEST_NO)), cut them into supplier cases and blocks (ASN options) into the temporary table TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H / TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D.

To give ASN Crossdock Creation (XD10) the delivery plan per Part Number + Customer Order Date with Case Qty, PO Readiness (case), the ASN options (blocks that can be sent) and the status Ready / Partially Ready / Not Ready.
It runs when the user clicks [Search] on XD10; there is no scheduler. The real mapping is done later by [Create ASN] on XD10.

Crossdock PO (decided 20-Oct): the order is taken from the manifest with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X' and its part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (MANIFEST_NO). The PO line is identified by MANIFEST_NO + MANIFEST_ITEM (PO_ITEM can differ from MANIFEST_ITEM; one PO can have several manifests).
Table concept from the DR XD09 (11-Nov): the draft is kept in TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H (one row per unit) and TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D (one row per pc), per company of the login user.

steps: The user clicks [Search] on ASN Crossdock Creation (XD10) with Delivery Date and Rit. The rows of the company of the login user (LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4) = company code) are deleted from TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H and TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D; company 1000 (TMMIN) keeps the rows of the other companies (DR).

steps.text: Get the customer order lines from TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE:
children: ORDER_STATUS = '7' (Cross Dock), UPD_STATUS IS NULL (no status change in GTOPAS), HOLD_FLAG = 'N', PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N'; latest data; open qty = ORDER_STATUS_QTY - qty of the line already in TB_R_INSTRUCTION (> 0). Lines changed in GTOPAS (UPD_STATUS '6' / '2', set by XD08) are not taken.
Get: Customer Code, Customer Order No, Order Date, Order Time, Destination Code, Detailed Item No, Serial No, Part Number, Order Status Qty; Pcs/Case of the part from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.

steps.text: Get the PO parts from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST + TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART:
children: manifests with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X'; their part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (join MANIFEST_NO); latest data; open PO qty = REMAIN_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (as is when no row) > 0; ordered by Order Date ascending (FIFO).
Get: PO Number, Manifest Number, Supplier Code / Plant, Sub Supplier Code / Plant, Order Type, Dock Code, PO Order Qty, Order Date, ETD Ori, Manifest Item, Part Number.

steps.text: Per unit (Part Number + Customer Order Date, oldest date first), pre-map in H0253 order (see 4.1 and 4.2) and insert the result in TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H / TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D.
children: Lines in H0253 order: 1) Allocation Priority (= Customer Order Date), 2) Customer Code, 3) Customer Order No, 4) Customer Order Date, 5) Customer Order Time, 6) Destination Code, 7) Detailed Item No, 8) Serial No.

Pour the open PO qty of the part (PO_DT, then PO No) over the lines from the top down: each line takes from the oldest PO with qty left; PO left < line qty -> the line is split per PO; no PO left -> the rest of the line gets PO_NO NULL (see 4.2).
The pcs are cut into supplier cases of PCS_CASE pcs in this order (a case can hold several lines and destinations); each slice line x PO x case is one row.

steps.text: Mark the valid cuts, number the blocks, set the status of each block and return the delivery plan to XD10 (see 4.3).
children: Error: clear the temporary table, show the error on the screen and record the Log (FAILED).

func_desc.text: XD09 runs on [Search] of XD10 and writes the draft of the delivery plan in TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H / TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D (table concept of the DR XD09 (11-Nov)). [Create ASN] (XD10) writes TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG and REMAIN_QTY. Examples: simulasi_asn_rev.xlsx (sheet Sample Input).
4.0 Draft tables (16-Nov, from the DR XD09)

items: TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H: one row per unit (Customer Order Date + Part Number + supplier): ORDER_STATUS_QTY = open qty of the unit, CASE = Case Qty, SUBMIT_ASN_STS.

TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D: one row per pc. The customer order line is broken down to 1 (ORDER_STATUS_QTY 1) and the PO qty is broken down to 1 (PO_QTY 1 with PO_NO); a pc without PO keeps PO_NO NULL and PO_QTY 0. The qty of a line with a PO = number of its rows with that PO_NO.

CASE_NO: the pcs are given a case label in the H0253 order of 4.1: supplier (sub supplier when it exists) + plant + initial palletize code + next CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ of TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ; the same CASE_NO is used until PCS_CASE pcs. [Create ASN] / Submit use this CASE_NO.

Rows of the company of the login user (LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4) = company code) are deleted and inserted again at each [Search]; company 1000 (TMMIN, D/S team) sees all suppliers and keeps the rows of the other companies.
Held pcs (Hold per case, Part Number on hold) are written with HOLD_STS 'Y', PO_NO NULL and no CASE_NO.
CUT_FLAG, GROUP_SEQ, CROSSDOCK_STATUS, SEQ_NO and CUSTOMER_CD are added to the DR table for the rules below.

The H0253 replicate has the lines of a Customer Order Date from the next day (XD08 run). A line is taken when ORDER_STATUS = 7, UPD_STATUS IS NULL, HOLD_FLAG = N and open qty > 0 (open qty = ORDER_STATUS_QTY - qty of the line in TB_R_INSTRUCTION).

Not taken: a line on hold (CO-14102 on 16-Oct), a cancelled line (UPD_STATUS 2: CO-14102 from 17-Oct, CO-14104 from 19-Oct), a line received in GTOPAS (UPD_STATUS 6: CO-14111 on 21-Oct), the qty already in an ASN (CO-14115: open 6 after ASN0006, 0 after ASN0007).

Order of the lines (ORDER BY): ORDER_DT (Allocation Priority), CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME, DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO, per unit = Part Number + Customer Order Date, units of a part oldest date first. Example 18-Oct: CO-14105, CO-14106, CO-14107 (9715300), CO-14104 (9722D10), CO-14109 (9811100), CO-14110 (982200). SORT_SEQ = row number per unit.
One PO per Part Number per Customer Order Date: PO date = order date + 1, PO qty = total order qty of all destinations of that date. Open PO qty = REMAIN_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART.

Pouring (Part Number level): the open PO qty of the part is poured over the customer order lines from the top of the list (order of 4.1, oldest unit first) down, like filling holes one after the other.

Each line takes its qty from the oldest PO that still has qty left (PO_DT, then PO No). The PO is used up before the next PO is taken; what is left of a PO goes on to the next line, also of the next Customer Order Date.

PO left < qty of the line: the line is split. The first part gets the rest of this PO; the rest goes on to the next PO (one row per PO). Example: line 6 pcs, PO A has 2 left, PO B has 10 -> 2 rows: PO A 2, PO B 4.

No PO left: the rest of the line is still written, with PO_NO NULL (not skipped). Example: line 6 pcs, PO A has 2 left, no other PO -> 2 rows: PO A 2, PO_NO NULL 4. The lines below also get PO_NO NULL.

Each pc is one row of TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D with its PO (PO_QTY 1); the number of rows of a line = its open qty. A PO qty left by an order that is not sent goes to the next lines: PO-0001 (CO-14102 on hold, then cancelled) covers CO-14103; PO-0002 then covers CO-14105.

PO qty lower than the order qty of the date (Short PO) is an abnormality: order date 17-Oct = 30 pcs, PO left 24 (PO-0002 6 + PO-0003 18); the last 6 pcs (CO-14110) have no PO (PO_NO NULL) and wait for the split PO PO-0004 of 19-Oct.
Pcs held by the D/S team (TB_R_CROSSDOCK_CASE_HOLD, 4.3) are not poured: the PO qty goes on to the next lines.

func_desc.text: 4.2 PO Assignment - example of the pouring
18-Oct [Search], order date 17-Oct, PART-X: PO left of the part (PO-0002 6 + PO-0003 18 = 24) poured from the top line down; 30 pcs ordered.

items: The pcs of a unit are cut into supplier cases of PCS_CASE pcs in the order of 4.1 (CASE_NO per case, in the H0253 order). A case can hold several lines: case 2 of 17-Oct = CO-14106 3 + CO-14107 3. A line can be in several cases: CO-14115 12 pcs = cases 1 and 2.

CUT_FLAG = Y after a case where the cumulative qty of every destination of the unit is a multiple of PCS_CASE (the warehouse packs 1 case = 1 destination); the ASN may stop only there. SEQ_QTY = fill of the warehouse case of the destination (1..PCS_CASE).
A case is Ready (CROSSDOCK_STATUS 6) when it and every earlier case of the unit have a PO, else Not Ready (7). 18-Oct: cases 1-4 Ready, case 5 Not Ready → unit Partially Ready, Short PO.
Holds of the D/S team (XD10 5.3, decided 13-Nov): a Part Number with HOLD_FLAG Y in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_PART_HOLD -> every case of its units CROSSDOCK_STATUS '8' (On Hold).

Lines held in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_CASE_HOLD (decided 14-Nov): HOLD_QTY pcs of the line are taken out of the open qty BEFORE the PO pouring (4.2) and the case cut: they take no PO, the PO qty goes on to the next lines of the part (same date, then the next Customer Order Dates); the held pcs are written with PO_NO NULL and CROSSDOCK_STATUS '8' (On Hold). The other cases are cut from the rest and keep their own readiness. Example 18-Oct: CO-14109 Taiwan 6 held -> PO-0003 6 goes to CO-14110 Australia; PART-X 17-Oct = 4 cases, all Ready.
Held line no longer open (cancelled in GTOPAS or open qty 0) -> row deleted; HOLD_QTY > open qty -> only the open qty is held.

Released lines (HOLD_FLAG N, FB-183): poured and cut at the END of their Customer Order Date (after the other lines of that date, before the newer dates), so the lines that took the PO while it was held keep it; the released line takes the next PO with qty left.

One row per unit with its cases (Case, Qty, Remaining Qty without PO, PO, status) and the PO check (order qty of the date vs PO qty). Units without a pre-mapped case and units fully in an ASN are not listed.

Per Part Number the oldest Customer Order Date is sent first: on 19-Oct the cases of 18-Oct can be ticked only together with or after case 1 of 17-Oct (CO-14110). A Not Ready case of an older date holds the later dates.

After the receiving in GTOPAS XD08 sets UPD_STATUS 6 and the line is no longer taken; a partly received line is split into a new SERIAL_NO and each part stays with its ASN (CO-14115: serial 0000001 = ASN0006, serial 0000002 = ASN0007), so nothing is taken again.

Query: H0253 lines in H0253 order (Allocation Priority = Customer Order Date)
WITH MAPPED AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO, SUM(QTY) AS MAPPED_QTY
FROM TB_R_INSTRUCTION
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO),
OPEN_LINE AS (SELECT H.*, H.ORDER_DT AS ALLOCATION_PRIORITY,
H.ORDER_STATUS_QTY - COALESCE(M.MAPPED_QTY, 0) AS OPEN_ORDER_QTY
FROM TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE H
LEFT JOIN MAPPED M ON M.CUSTOMER_CD = H.CUSTOMER_CD AND M.CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO = H.CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO
AND M.ORDER_DT = H.ORDER_DT AND M.DESTINATION_CD = H.DESTINATION_CD
AND M.DETAILED_ITEM_NO = H.DETAILED_ITEM_NO AND M.SERIAL_NO = H.SERIAL_NO
WHERE H.ORDER_STATUS = '7' AND H.UPD_STATUS IS NULL AND H.HOLD_FLAG = 'N' AND H.PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N')
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SHIPPING_PART_NO, ORDER_DT
ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO) AS SORT_SEQ,
SHIPPING_PART_NO, ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO, ORDER_STATUS_QTY, OPEN_ORDER_QTY
FROM OPEN_LINE
WHERE OPEN_ORDER_QTY > 0
ORDER BY SHIPPING_PART_NO, ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO

tables.name: TB_T_INSTRUCTION_H
tables.description: Draft of ASN Crossdock, header (DR XD09 (11-Nov)): one row per unit = Customer Order Date + Part Number + supplier. Written by XD09 at [Search] of XD10 for the company of the login user: its rows (LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4) = company code) are deleted and inserted again; company 1000 (TMMIN, D/S team) sees every supplier.
columns: Open qty of the unit = SUM(H0253.ORDER_STATUS_QTY) of the lines not on hold and not yet in TB_R_INSTRUCTION
Case Qty of the unit = number of supplier cases (CEILING(ORDER_STATUS_QTY / TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.PCS_CASE))
'Y' the unit has Ready cases that can go into an ASN / 'N' not (DR; also named GENERATE_ASN_STS in the DR Data Map, refer FB-193)
Login user; LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4) = company code of the user (rows of the company)

tables.name: TB_T_INSTRUCTION_D
tables.description: Draft of ASN Crossdock, detail (DR XD09 (11-Nov)): one row per pc. The customer order line is broken down to 1 pc per row (ORDER_STATUS_QTY = 1) and the PO qty is broken down to 1 (PO_QTY = 1). The pcs of a supplier case share one CASE_NO. Columns marked (added) are not in the DR but needed by the rules of 4.1-4.3.
columns: (added) Sequence of the pc in the unit in the H0253 order of 4.1; key of the row
(added) H0253.CUSTOMER_CD (order key 1, needed for the H0253 order and TB_R_INSTRUCTION)
Always 1 (customer order line broken down to 1 pc)
PO of the pc (pouring of 4.2: oldest PO first); NULL when no PO is left or the pc is held
1 when the pc has a PO (PO qty broken down to 1); 0 when PO_NO is NULL

Supplier case (case label) of the pc: supplier (sub supplier when it exists) + plant + initial palletize code + next CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ of TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ; the same CASE_NO for PCS_CASE pcs in H0253 order (DR); NULL for a held pc
(added) 'Y' on the pcs of a case after which the ASN may stop (every destination of the unit a multiple of PCS_CASE, 4.3)
(added) Case Group: the cases up to and including a valid cut; sent together
(added) '6' Ready / '7' Not Ready / '8' On Hold (D/S) of the case group
'Y' pc held by the D/S team (Hold per case, Part Number on hold): no PO, no CASE_NO; NULL otherwise
Login user; LEFT(CREATE_BY, 4) = company code of the user (rows of the company)

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_PART_HOLD
tables.description: New table: Part Number put on hold by the D/S team on ASN Crossdock Creation (sub screen Hold per Part). HOLD_FLAG Y = no ASN can be created for the part, whatever the Customer Order Date. Name and columns proposed.

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_CASE_HOLD
tables.description: New table: customer order lines (pcs) of a supplier case held by the D/S team with the Hold check box (decided 14-Nov). The held pcs leave the unit before the PO pouring of XD09: they take no PO, the PO qty goes on to the next orders, the other cases stay Ready with their own PO. Released (unticked) = HOLD_FLAG N, kept until the line is fully in an ASN or cancelled (FB-183). Name and columns proposed.
columns: Customer Order Date of the unit
Held pcs of the line (sum of the line pcs in the held cases); not more than the open qty of the line
'Y' on hold / 'N' released: the line goes to the end of its Customer Order Date in the PO pouring (FB-183)
Login user (D/S team) who created the record
Login user (D/S team) who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART
tables.description: Existing Pra Daily Order part (one row per manifest item). Crossdock uses ORDER_QTY and REMAIN_QTY of the parts of the manifests with CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X': open PO qty = REMAIN_QTY (no new mapped-qty table, decided 16-Nov).
columns: Qty of the PO part not yet in an ASN: open PO qty of XD09; reduced by [Create ASN] (XD10), added back on Back / Cancel, submit error and XD08 release
